    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnimatedEntity
    Represents an animated object in an isometric grid.
    AnimatedOrientedSprite
    Represents an oriented sprite with multiple animation frames.
    AnimatedOrientedSprite.Builder
    Provides Builder functionality.
    AnimatedSprites
    Provides predefined animated sprites for characters and creatures.
    CrusaderCombatSounds
    Synthesizes short combat sound effects for the crusader.
    CrusaderStaticSounds
    Plays synthesized sound effects for stationary crusader animations.
    Entity
    Represents a static object in a three-dimensional isometric scene.
    FloorTile
    Represents a floor tile drawn below objects on the same level.
    FootstepSound
    Plays a short, synthesized footstep sound effect.
    IsometricSprites
    Provides predefined isometric sprites for terrain, objects, structures, walls, and stairs.
    IsometricSprites.CornerFace
    One independently rendered, independently occluding face of a corner.
    OccludingEntity
    An upright structure that can occlude characters at another elevation.
    Orientation
    World-space facing or tile side: EAST = +X, NORTH = +Y.
    OrientedSprite
    Represents a sprite whose texture depends on its orientation.
    OrientedSprite.Builder
    Represents Builder in the rendering system.
    PalisadeSprite
    A wooden palisade aligned with one edge of a diamond-shaped floor tile.
    RampSprite
    A one-tile walkable ramp.
    Renderable
    Defines an object that can be positioned and rendered in an isometric scene.
    Scene
    Public API for an isometric scene.
    Sprite
    Represents Sprite in the rendering system.
